$comment: Wire shape only. Server must enforce authenticated owner/live session and epoch, Origin/CSRF, exact Java TZDB membership, strict integer-only JSON, duplicate-key/header/query rejection, canonical request cap 4096 bytes, transactional versioning and session-bound HMAC idempotency. No scheduling, translation or inference personalization is enabled.

anyOf.description: Exact unnormalized Unicode scalar text; 1..80 codepoints, at most 320 UTF-8 bytes; no ISO controls, not entirely Unicode White_Space plus FEFF. Null explicitly clears.

timezone.description: ASCII lexical candidate only. Exact case-sensitive membership in server startup set is mandatory: UTC plus Java ZoneId available IDs containing / except SystemV/. Preserve aliases exactly. Neither regex nor ZoneId.of alone proves support.
